established_continuity: Eleven months after Adam's reported death, his buried key opened Evelyn's home and Sophie said Daddy was directing her.
The narrator learned she is Evelyn Ward, not Claire; after the crash a surgeon reconstructed her face, while the scarred woman first called Mara claims she is Claire.
A pre-crash video showed Adam and Evelyn planning to remove Claire, but several images and messages may have been staged or mirrored.
Adam's grave was empty. A recent-looking image suggested he survived, while the surgeon was visible filming the three adults escaping the burning car.
The surgeon claimed Claire was reconstructed to resemble Evelyn, reversing Claire's account of the face swap.
DNA evidence says Evelyn is Sophie's biological mother. Claire says Adam swapped their newborns because Evelyn's son was ill and Claire's son was healthy.
A hidden nursery named Sophie and Thomas was found. A boy resembling Adam appeared inside Sophie's bedroom and asked Evelyn why she chose Sophie.
Adam, the surgeon, Claire, Sophie, and possibly Thomas can all manipulate evidence. Evelyn's memories remain unreliable.
The central mysteries must remain unresolved: whether Adam lives, who engineered the crash and surgeries, Thomas's true identity, and what Evelyn knowingly did.
